description_en: Resumes a suspended task flow instance
description_zh: 调用ResumeTaskFlowInstance接口，恢复已暂停运行的任务流
name: ResumeTaskFlowInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution record of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html operation to query the execution record ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行记录ID（Id），可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424682.html operation to query the version number
parameters.help_zh: 任务流版本号。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424682.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_version
